answer.verdict: Four fixes are on eb8688b in external/ps2recomp-pr10: CVT.W.S chops and saturates, VCLIP uses the PCSX2 side-bit order, macro FMAC writes vu0_mac_flags and replaces vu0_status, VFTOI saturates. SQRT.S is not included. Rerun: 449 tests, 449 passed, 0 failed.

facts.c: Upstream FPU_CVT_W_S was (int32_t)nearbyintf. PCSX2 v2.8.2 CVT_W chops when (bits&0x7F800000)<=0x4E800000 and otherwise returns 0x7fffffff or 0x80000000. ps2_cvt_w_s now does that test and FPU_CVT_W_S calls it. The emitter is still FPU_CVT_W_S(ctx->f[fs]).
Audit log: .text cvt.w.s count is 497 and ctc1 count is 0, so the game never changes the EE reset chop mode.
VU0_S2_VCLIPw now calls ps2_vu_clip. PCSX2 _vuCLIP forces exp-0 w to 0x007fffff, sets bit0 x>+|w| 0x01 and bit1 x<-|w| 0x02, then y and z, shifts the history by 6, and keeps 24 bits.
Audit log: vclipw n=35 and cfc2.clip n=21. Every CLIP read is 5 to 15 instructions after a macro VCLIPw. First pair is 0x18ed08 then 0x18ed1c. None follows VCALLMS.

vu_fmac has 42 call sites. VOPMSUB and VOPMULA pass mask 0xE and clear_absent false. Other wraps pass dest_mask and true. CFC2 MAC already read ctx->vu0_mac_flags. PCSX2 VU_MAC_UPDATE uses shifts x=3,y=2,z=1,w=0 and VU_STAT_UPDATE assigns statusflag = the Z/S/U/O summary.
Audit log: cfc2.mac n=4, all after macro ALU and none after VCALLMS: 0x191a80 after VADD, 0x191b5c two instructions after VADD, 0x1938d0 five instructions after VOPMSUB, 0x1d6e98 the same pattern.
translateVU_VFTOI calls ps2_vftoi(src, shift). PCSX2 floatToInt saturates when the exponent is >= 0x4F000000. Audit log: VFTOI0 n=15, VFTOI4 n=25. VITOF is unchanged.
SQRT.S emitter on this tree is still FPU_SQRT_S(ctx->f[fs]). fpu_translator.cpp is not in the diff. The float test does not add the PR #382 SQRT.S ft assertion.
Tracked diff is the five OWNS files. Untracked build_pr_tests.cmd was already present. HEAD eb8688b2fd191129f103a39543002c005b33409c, branch ee-fpu-vu0-macro-semantics.
facts.ref: git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD; git branch --show-current

facts.c: build_pr_tests.cmd first run: Total 449, Passed 448, Failed 1. The failed run is unowned EE Timer2 compare IRQ (150 ms wait). The four new runs passed in that same log.
Rerun of the same ps2x_tests.exe with no run.lock: exit 0, Total 449, Passed 449, Failed 0. CVT.W.S, VCLIP, FMAC, and VFTOI runs passed.

fix.change: Added ps2_vu_clip, ps2_vu_mac_lane, ps2_vu_mac_apply, ps2_vftoi, and ps2_cvt_w_s. FPU_CVT_W_S calls ps2_cvt_w_s.
VU0_S2_VCLIPw calls ps2_vu_clip and keeps the ft field broadcast.
vu_fmac wraps 42 FMAC translators. VOPMSUB and VOPMULA use mask 0xE and clear_absent false. VFTOI calls ps2_vftoi.
Ported PS2VuFpuFixes: VCLIP side bits, FMAC MAC word, VFTOI saturation, plus emitter checks.
CVT.W.S emitter check added to the DIV/RSQRT run, plus the chop-and-saturate run. SQRT.S ft assertion from patch 16 was not added.

contra: ps2_vu_mac_lane flags the value PS2_VADD/VSUB/VMUL already stored. PCSX2 VU_MAC_UPDATE flags the pre-clamp result and, on exponent 255 with overflow clamp, returns 0x7F7FFFFF (VUflags.cpp:37-42). A lane already clamped to 0x7FFFFFFF does not raise O. A denormal flushed by PS2_V* arrives as signed zero, so the lane is S|Z rather than U.

vu0_status is replaced by the Z/S/U/O summary, matching interpreter VU_STAT_UPDATE (VUflags.cpp:89-96), not microVU sticky flags. Audit cfc2.status reads at 0x293b8c, 0x293bec, and 0x293c60 include two that follow CTC2 status plus VSUBs, so those reads see the VSUB summary.
The first test process exited 1 (449/448/1) on an unowned 150 ms Timer2 wait. The rerun of the same binary exited 0 (449/449/0). FPU_CVT_W_S has no caller in ps2xRuntime outside the macro.
